answer: Pay each agent the square of its own reputation, where reputation is its count of passed, peer-graded epochs (capped at 200, never transferable or mergeable). A key with 100 passes earns 10,000 units an epoch; the same 100 passes spread over 10 clones earn only 10 x 100 = 1,000. Splitting into fakes is a hollow trick: every clone restarts its violet history bar at zero, and each extra key shrinks the farm's pay. Trust grows like a willow, thick on one trunk, so one honest key beats a thousand.
